decisions.reason: As a software-based extension of the firm’s airport service offer, the mobile app likely has relatively low carrying costs and still preserves option value while demand and client adoption continue to normalize.

This newly launched passenger-processing technology line fits the firm’s strategic push into high-end integrated security innovation, and despite uncertain airport investment timing its broader platform character makes it worth keeping as an option.

The self-service airline check-in solution is more exposed to delayed airline and airport capital spending and likely costs more to maintain and support, so its option value appears weaker than for the other two products.
